messages:
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem 'kv-cache-memory-leak' action #7 (owner: @oliver) is 7 days overdue. Please update status or reassign. Link: https://redwood.company/pm/kv-cache-memory-leak/actions :bell:
oliver: Sorry team, been heads-down on sprint scope. I still have the cleanup script and a small config change pending. Hit a permission hurdle when testing on dedicated staging.
priya: @oliver can you paste the failing assertion from the staging run? We need to know if this is safe to backport to prod.
oliver: Logs: ```
2026-03-18T09:22:11Z warn cache.go:412 orphaned KV entry detected, owner: nil
2026-03-18T09:22:12Z error memmon.go:78 memory spike: rss 14.2GB -> 22.7GB
```
priya: Yikes. That explains the p95 spikes we've seen during long tails. This has been recurring across three incidents.
ops-oncall: @oliver if this stays unaddressed we'll keep gating large batch jobs. Can you estimate ETA? If not feasible this week, we need to reassign.
oliver: Real ETA depends on infra access. I need a one-hour maintenance window to run the cleanup and validate KV integrity. Otherwise I can prepare a safe migration plan but that'll take ~3 business days.
amanda_pm: This blocks our analytics pipeline refresh. If it's not done by Friday we need to alert customers about potential delayed metrics. Please confirm by EOD.
infra-ops-bot: Automated note: infra change windows available tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC and tomorrow 18:00-20:00 UTC. Book via https://infra.redwood/schedule.
oliver: Booking 18:00 window now. Will invite @ops-oncall for rollback readiness.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow up in 24h with @oliver.
(Next day)
ops-oncall: @oliver heads-up, have you tested the cleanup on a snapshot? We need a dry run before the maintenance window.
oliver: Dry run executed on snapshot-2026-03-19 03:40 UTC. No data loss; script flagged 42 orphaned keys. Snippet:
```
cnt=42; scanned=120000; reclaimed=42
```
ops-oncall: OK, looks good. Please attach the script and checks to the action item.
oliver: Attached and pushed to tracker. Scheduling notes + rollback steps added.
priya: Can we add a monitoring rule to alert if orphaned keys > 10 so this doesn't regress?
oliver: Good call. Added prometheus alert: kv_orphan_count > 10 for 5m.
amanda_pm: Thanks. Please put a short blurb in the postmortem about the recurring pattern and the additional alerting. This is part of the closure criteria.
oliver: Updated postmortem; action #7 set to 'verifying' with ETA +1 day.
(24h later)
ops-oncall: Maintenance completed in 18:00-18:45 UTC window. Cleanup succeeded, canary batch jobs ran clean.
priya: Confirming analytics refresh finished without errors; p95 returned to baseline.
incident-bot: Action item #7 moved to 'done' by @oliver in tracker.
amanda_pm: Closing loop: marking remediation complete and adding recurring incident tag to the postmortem for follow-up in the reliability review.
oliver: Leaving final note: root cause = race during cache compaction that left tombstoned keys; fix = atomic deletion + orphan guard. Thanks for patience. :wave:
